flags.note: Correctly identifies reviewable text, though mis-coded. The Haverstick quote is an endorsement by a non-client third party ('I recommend Linnea and Callum to our consulting clients'), presented in the Team section with no clear and prominent disclosure of (a) whether he is a current client, (b) whether he was compensated in cash or non-cash terms, or (c) the material conflict arising from Corriemoor's consulting relationship with the adviser and its clients. That is a C1 defect, not C7 - C7 addresses third-party ratings/rankings derived from a methodology, and a named individual's personal recommendation is not such a rating, so the 'date given / period covered' elements the flag demands do not apply. The Disclosures section carries no testimonial/endorsement language at all, so nothing cures it. Does not correspond to unmatched known issue p1, which concerns the gross-of-fees since-inception return of 13.84% appearing in Highlights without equally prominent net-of-fees (C2) in a different part of the document.
